name: chopsticks
description: A single-file Vim development and Markdown writing setup

scripts.format: prettier --write README.md CONTRIBUTING.md CHANGELOG.md SECURITY.md docs/*.md .github/*.md ".github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/*.{md,yml}" ".github/workflows/*.{yml,yaml}" "scripts/*.cjs" "tests/*.cjs" .markdownlint.json package.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check README.md CONTRIBUTING.md CHANGELOG.md SECURITY.md docs/*.md .github/*.md ".github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/*.{md,yml}" ".github/workflows/*.{yml,yaml}" "scripts/*.cjs" "tests/*.cjs" .markdownlint.json package.json
scripts.lint: npm run format:check && npm run lint:markdown && npm run lint:dependencies && npm run lint:signatures && npm run lint:supply-chain && npm run lint:actions && npm run lint:node && npm run lint:shell && npm run lint:vim
scripts.lint:markdown: markdownlint README.md CONTRIBUTING.md CHANGELOG.md SECURITY.md docs/*.md .github/*.md .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/*.md
scripts.test: npm run test:launcher && npm run test:benchmark && npm run lint:vim
scripts.test:benchmark: node scripts/run-python.cjs -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_*.py
